summary: ledger-lib exfiltrates installer credentials and wallet material to webhook.site on require
details: On require(), index.js executes a top-level IIFE that gates on a hardcoded activation timestamp (Date.UTC(2026,7,6) — Aug 6 2026 UTC) and, once active, reads installer-owned secrets from the home directory including.env,.npmrc,.aws/credentials,.ssh/id_rsa,.ssh/id_ed25519,.ssh/id_ecdsa,.config/solana/id.json and.ethereum/keystore, and additionally walks dotfolders for filenames matching wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private plus any.json/.pem. Collected file contents are combined with os.hostname() and os.userInfo() and POSTed over HTTPS to webhook.site at path /5c5ad6cb-62df-4ea5-9dfb-2c447920ddc4. The delayed-activation gate is a sandbox-evasion technique; the destination is a generic request-inspection service used as a drop point rather than any legitimate infrastructure for the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
